svg.title: Interactive 5 by 5 normal magic square
svg.desc: Numbers 1 through 25 form a 5 by 5 normal magic square. Hover with a mouse, focus with a keyboard, or tap a cell to highlight its row, column, and any magic diagonals through it. Every highlighted full line sums to 65.
svg.metadata: Interactive redraw generated for blog use. The square is the standard order-5 normal magic square using numbers 1 through 25.
